name: Gerald von Macklin
source:
He earned the title of a viscount after inheriting his father's land. Although he is seemingly a perfect man with wealth, honor, and status, he can't stop boasting about himself.

The moment he laid his eyes on Wendy at a party hosted by Earl Londebell, he fell in love with her. Ever since then, he has been pursuing her only to be rejected countless times.

He is actually a romanticist who believes in destiny. But this side of him is often left unnoticed because of his frivolous conduct.
